conditions: The same diff must replace the decided tag at src/view.pure.ts:29 and the value-only postcondition at :27 with the new diagram meaning; removing only the r.typeOnly guard is insufficient.

source.ambiguity: A schema-oriented diagram could reasonably choose otherwise, but the same output currently has a documented value-import meaning; package-node creation already seeing an import does not mean its connection is drawn.
